title: On Bouncing twice on the stone floor
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：bounce　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bounce 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the fisherman ① bounced twice on the stone floor in silence, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the fisherman ② bounces twice on the stone floor twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ bounce twice on the stone floor at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ bounced twice on the stone floor before — a line in the logbook for July 1948 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Bouncing twice on the stone floor in silence, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ bounce the old ball against the wall twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Bounce the old ball against the wall at once and never mention it again.

By 1961 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a new boatman from the next harbour ⑧ bounces the old ball against the wall in silence every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pier, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ bounced twice on the stone floor again when nobody else would.

⑩ To bounce twice on the stone floor, my mother said in 1966, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, somebody bounces twice on the stone floor twice over again and somebody must bounce twice on the stone floor in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 弹起（一般过去式 bounced twice on the stone floor：1954 年渔人头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 弹起（一般现在 bounces twice on the stone floor：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 弹起（不定式 to bounce twice on the stone floor：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 弹起（过去完成时 had bounced twice on the stone floor：1948 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 弹起（动名词 bouncing twice on the stone floor 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 拍（bounce the old ball against the wall：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去拍把那只旧球朝墙上拍）
G. v. 拍（bounce the old ball against the wall：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 弹起（后段两处：新来的船工照例 bounces the old ball against the wall，而母亲又一次 bounced twice on the stone floor）

answers.why: bounce 意为“弹起”，1954 年渔人一言不发地弹起在石头地上弹了两下，那是渔港里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 bounced。
bounce 意为“弹起”，自那以后渔人来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 bounces。
bounce 意为“弹起”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯弹起在石头地上弹了两下”，此处为不定式 to bounce twice on the stone floor。
bounce 意为“弹起”，航海日志里 七月 那行字说明早在 1961 年之前就有人弹起过，故用过去完成时 had bounced。
bounce 意为“弹起”，渔人说“弹起在石头地上弹了两下这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 bouncing twice on the stone floor 作主语。
bounce 意为“拍”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去拍把那只旧球朝墙上拍”，should ever 之后用原形 bounce the old ball against the wall。
bounce 意为“拍”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻拍把那只旧球朝墙上拍（bounce the old ball against the wall at once），以后再也不要提起。
bounce 意为“弹起”，新来的船工每个汛期都照例拍把那只旧球朝墙上拍，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 bounces。
bounce 意为“弹起”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地弹起在石头地上弹了两下，用一般过去式 bounced 叙述。
bounce 意为“弹起”，结尾那句是母亲 1966 年的话：要弹起在石头地上弹了两下，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 bounce 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the fisherman bounced twice on the stone floor in silence, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
Even now the fisherman bounces twice on the stone floor twice over whenever the harbour asks.
Bouncing twice on the stone floor in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever bounce the old ball against the wall twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new boatman from the next harbour bounces the old ball against the wall in silence every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother bounced twice on the stone floor again, and the harbour remembered that half.
